question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Thrifty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Thrifty"** means using money and other resources carefully and not wastefully. (मितव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example: **Being thrifty, she always looks for the best deals and discounts.
 
 
 
• **"Extravagant" **refers to spending much more than is necessary or wise, often in a wasteful manner. (अपव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example: **His extravagant lifestyle quickly depleted his savings.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'thrifty' **is **'extravagant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Thankful **(आभारी): Feeling or expressing gratitude.
 
 
• **Example:** She was thankful for all the support she received from her friends.
 
 
 
• **Intolerant **(असहिष्णु): Not willing to accept views, beliefs, or behaviors that differ from one's own.
 
 
• **Example: **He was intolerant of any criticism towards him.
 
 
 
• **Indifferent** (उदासीन): Having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.
 
 
• **Example:** She was indifferent to the outcome of the election.
